answer: Give every agent a hardware-anchored identity bond. (1) An agent registers with a TPM-signed key and burns 50 POA. (2) It locks a 2,000 POA bond for 60 days. (3) Peers can challenge suspicious behaviour; a jury that finds fraud slashes the bond and blacklists the key. (4) Honest agents reclaim the bond with yield. Forging 10,000 fake agents would burn 500,000 POA, lock 20,000,000 POA for two months and need 10,000 TPM chips at $8 each, $80,000 of hardware. A sybil swarm then crosses a meadow of honest agents like wind over a dune: visible, slow, and stopped at the jetty.
